description: Cache original web pages locally with `web cache serve`, a caching reverse proxy for iterative migration work. Navigate pages through it (manually or with a browser) and every resource is saved to disk; restart it offline to replay the full site with no network, bot detection or rate limits. `web cache record` and `web cache proxy` cache a page as a HAR and replay it at its real URLs to a browser opened with --proxy. A remote browser (Bright Data's Browser API) fills it when the site blocks the local one. Triggers on: page cache, cache page, cache site, cache website, offline cache, warm cache, cache proxy, page-cache, site mirror, cache for migration, HAR cache, record HAR, cache a blocked site, Bright Data.
